title: Leaf-cutter ant mounds resembling a Mesoamerican city at La Venta

tellings.quote: I was in Mexico. I was I was at this ch site called Lventa. I'm standing at at the base of the Great Pyramid of Lamenta

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns says that at La Venta, an ancient site in Mexico with a great pyramid, he noticed that the mounds built by leaf-cutter ants looked like a small version of an ancient Mexican city. He tells Michels he saw this himself while standing at the base of the pyramid, and offers it as a clue to how such cities may have been laid out.
